title: Respect less-motion settings
summary: Some people feel unwell when a page moves a lot.
introduction: Some people feel unwell when a page moves a lot. Your task: Turn on reduced motion in your system and compare the card.
learningObjectives: Turn on reduced motion in your system and compare the card.
Explain the example for respect less-motion settings

blocks.text: Some people feel unwell when a page moves a lot. The reduced-motion setting asks pages to use less movement.

Try runnable HTML here with a keyboard as well as a mouse. A screen reader is a tool that reads page information aloud. Test real pages with people and tools; one automated check cannot prove everything works.

blocks.code: Reading card
blocks.title: Respect less-motion settings

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `prefers-reduced-motion` checks a user preference. The reduced version should still show all important content.
A media query only applies its enclosed styles when the stated condition matches. The other styles remain the starting rules.

blocks.text: The hover lift is removed when reduced motion is requested by the system.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not make important information available only through animation. The words should remain understandable without motion.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Turn on reduced motion in your system and compare the card.
